items.title: Why JSX Just Bought New Pacific Airlines, The Strange, Failed 757 Startup
items.why: Regional airline consolidation has limited direct impact on premium card transfer partners, but it shifts the frequent flyer landscape.
items.summary_ai: JSX has acquired New Pacific Airlines, a startup whose earlier 757 operation had failed.
items.take: Regional airline consolidation has limited direct impact on premium card transfer partners, but it shifts the frequent flyer landscape.
